newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen capped at recent highs in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen capped at recent highs in thin trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures were confined to a two-tick band in slow trade on Friday as players searched in vain for new incentives to push the market beyond recent highs.
Dealers said the market was unmoved by data showing Japan's industrial output fell a revised 3.2 percent in June from the previous month, compared with a preliminary estimate of a 3.1 percent fall.
The Trade Ministry said it expected July-September output to rise 0.2 percent from the previous quarter, compared with a previously forecast rise of 0.3 percent.
At 1115 GMT, the lead March Euroyen contract stood unchanged against an IMM close at 99.25, off its recent contract high of 99.26. Volume was a light 6,050 lots.
September JGBs ended at 126.85 against a previous 126.97 after hitting a new high of 127.08. Dealers said the contract faced resistance at 127.13/14 and 127.33.
Eurodollar futures ended firmer on spillover buying after the release of a tame U.S. Consumer Price Index for July.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.105 against an IMM close at 94.095. March were at 94.030 against 94.020. Resistance is seen at 94.08 and then at 94.12.
